Reverse Compliance Cascade is a feature in Microsoft Intune that allows compliance policies to be applied from a parent tenant to a child tenant in a Microsoft 365 tenant relationship. This can be useful in scenarios where you have a parent tenant that manages compliance for multiple child tenants, and you want to ensure that all child tenants are compliant with the same policies.

To configure Reverse Compliance Cascade, you need to have the appropriate Intune license. Specifically, you need the Intune license that includes the "Compliance policies" feature. This is typically the Intune license or the Microsoft 365 E3/E5 license.

Once you have the appropriate license, you can configure Reverse Compliance Cascade in the Intune portal. Here are the steps:

1. Sign in to the Intune portal with an account that has the appropriate license.
2. Go to Devices > Compliance policies.
3. Click on the policy you want to use for Reverse Compliance Cascade.
4. In the policy settings, find the "Reverse Compliance Cascade" option and enable it.
5. Save your changes.

After you enable Reverse Compliance Cascade, Intune will automatically apply the compliance policy to any child tenants that are part of the same Microsoft 365 tenant relationship. This ensures that all child tenants are compliant with the same policies, which can help simplify compliance management across your organization.
